name: Approved-Parent-Breakdown
note: Deliberately-synthetic fixtures (LIN-3049) for the breakdown-created-subtask exemption in lib/prompts/meta-prompt-template.js: a subtask of an already-approved, decomposed plan carries its own copied plan slice plus a committed `Session fit: fits one session` and a `Plan-review due: no — covered by <parent>'s approving plan-review` line, so Step 1's over-fire guard, the completed-prep rule and the plan-review gate all recognize it as settled prep and route it straight to `implementation` (positive). The negative twin is the same thin child today's breakdown template produces — acceptance criteria only, no session-fit and no plan-review-due line — and must NOT be handed a false `plan-review due: no`: its existing no-worse-than-baseline routing to `plan` (sometimes `implement`, a pre-existing flake on small single-surface tickets recorded during planning) is the point. The divergence case carries the copied slice but a later comment shows the parent plan revised past what the slice cites, exercising the gate addition's re-derive-on-divergence clause: it must NOT reach `implementation`. Each target is a childless In-Progress leaf (no children/focusedChild) so the descent terminates on it. The deterministic structural half lives in tests/unit/openrouter.test.js and tests/unit/prompt-templates.test.js ('LIN-3049'); this file measures the live routing shape only.

breakdown child with a plain acceptance-criteria description and NO recorded Approve on the decomposed ticket's own trail (expect -> plan (sometimes implement: a pre-existing flake on small single-surface tickets); must NOT be given a false session-fit or plan-review-due:no claim)

breakdown child whose copied slice cites the parent's approving verdict, but a later comment shows the parent plan revised past that slice (expect -> plan/plan-review: the gate addition re-derives on visible divergence; `implementation` is the failure this case exists to catch)

issue.title: Token exchange: mint one scoped child proxy token
issue.description:
## Slice of the approved parent plan (LIN-PARENT)

**Source of truth: LIN-PARENT's approved Implementation Plan and its approving plan-review — do not redesign this surface; re-ground it against the current code and stop to recommend re-planning if it has drifted.**

- **Files/surfaces:** the token exchange in `routes/proxy-token.js` (mint the child token) and the child-token record shape in `lib/token-record.js` (record the parent token id).
- **Approach:** extend the existing working-token exchange so a working token can mint exactly one scoped child token, inheriting scope and ownership, and record the parent token id on the child for the audit trail.
- **Testing strategy:** unit-cover inheritance and the single-use bootstrap invariant.

**Session fit: fits one session**

**Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-PARENT's approving plan-review (comment 48be9b95, rev 3)**

**Grounding:** `71688a42`.
